vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.noEntities: Not linked to any legal entity yet.
vendors.subject: Subject

bank.title: Bank details
bank.twoPersonNote: Every bank-detail change must be approved by a second, different person before it takes effect.
bank.queueIntro: You cannot approve a change you made yourself. Changes to an existing account, or requested by the vendor, need a callback to a known contact.
bank.callbackNeeded: Call the vendor on a number already on file and record the reference before approving.

admin.title: Administration
admin.sodNote: Roles that would let one person both prepare and approve the same thing cannot be assigned together.
admin.authorityNote: Spending limits per legal entity. Approval rules are applied by the workflow engine in a later release.

portal.invalidLink: This link is not valid or has expired. Ask your contact for a new one.
portal.acceptIntro: Hello {{name}}, set a password to finish creating your account.
portal.passwordRules: At least 12 characters. Do not use your email address.
portal.scanQr: Scan this code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
portal.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
portal.recoveryIntro: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe; they are shown only now.
portal.enterCode: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
portal.legalNameLocked: To change your legal name or tax number, contact the customer.
portal.scanNote: Files are scanned before they can be used.
portal.bankNote: Changes to bank details are checked by the customer, who will call you back before they take effect.
portal.noInvoices: You have not sent any invoices yet.
portal.submitInvoiceHelp: Enter the invoice details exactly as on your invoice and attach the file. The customer checks it before payment.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.fromDocumentHelp: Upload the supplier's invoice file. A draft is created for you to complete; nothing is read from the file automatically.
invoices.suggestionsHelp: These are only suggestions with a confidence. Check them against the document and type the values in yourself.
invoices.noSuggestions: Nothing was read from the file.

verification.title: Verification
verification.notYet: This invoice has not been verified yet.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.intro: Checks that failed and wait for a person. A flag can be accepted with a reason. A blocking check needs the override permission, and not the person who made the invoice.

verificationAdmin.title: Verification rules
verificationAdmin.intro: Which checks run on invoices of each legal entity, and how strict they are.
verificationAdmin.version: Settings version in force: {{version}} (0 means the built-in defaults).
verificationAdmin.pendingExists: A change is waiting for approval for this legal entity.
verificationAdmin.savedPending: The change loosens a check, so a second person must approve it before it applies.
verificationAdmin.looseningNote: Making a check weaker (turning it off, lowering it from Block to Flag, or widening a tolerance) needs approval from a different person.
verificationAdmin.note: Why are you changing the rules?
verificationAdmin.inboxIntro: You cannot approve a change you made yourself.
verificationAdmin.loosens: This change makes these checks weaker:

duplicate.exact.title: Exact duplicate
duplicate.exact.help: Same vendor, number, amount and date as another invoice.

duplicate.same_number.title: Same invoice number
duplicate.same_number.help: Same vendor and number as another invoice, with a different amount or date.

duplicate.fuzzy.title: Similar invoice
duplicate.fuzzy.help: A very similar number with nearly the same amount and date.

po.required.title: PO required
po.required.help: The invoice must name a purchase order.

po.match.title: Purchase order match
po.match.help: Price, quantity and total value against the purchase order.

amount.totals.title: Totals
amount.totals.help: Lines add up to the subtotal, and subtotal plus tax to the total.

amount.line_math.title: Line amounts
amount.line_math.help: Quantity times unit price equals each line amount.

tax.vat.title: VAT
tax.vat.help: VAT arithmetic and the checks of the entity's country.

date.sanity.title: Dates
date.sanity.help: Not future-dated, not too old, due date not before the invoice date.

vendor.state.title: Vendor status
vendor.state.help: The vendor must be active and linked to this entity. Always blocks.

ruleParams.checkSupplierTaxNumberFormat: Check supplier tax number format (1 = on)
ruleParams.matchVendorTaxNumber: Match vendor master tax number (1 = on)
ruleParams.checkAllowedRates: Check tax categories and rates (1 = on)

intake.title: Invoice intake
intake.unmatchedIntro: Email from senders we could not match to exactly one vendor. Nothing is guessed: choose the vendor, or dismiss the message.
intake.mailboxIntro: The mailbox each legal entity receives supplier invoices in. It is read through Microsoft Graph; sender addresses are matched to the contact email of active vendors.
intake.lastError: The last attempt to read this mailbox failed.
intake.ordersIntro: Purchase orders used for matching. Import them here until the ERP integration supplies them. Importing the same version again changes nothing.
